name: disable-the-sharepoint-online-add-shortcut-to-onedrive-feature
title: Disable the SharePoint Online Add Shortcut to OneDrive Feature
shortDescription: Disable the Add Shortcut to OneDrive feature at the SharePoint Online tenant level using certificate-based authentication.
longDescription: This PowerShell script connects to the SharePoint Online Tenant Administration site using certificate-based authentication and disables the Add Shortcut to OneDrive feature at the tenant level.
